mapper.select: SELECT office_seq, office_short_name, office_addr, office_tel, office_auth_yn, office_state_code, office_invite_code, del_yn, note FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_office_mst WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND office_auth_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY office_short_name ASC
SELECT office_seq, office_short_name, office_invite_code FROM utb_office_mst WHERE office_invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND del_yn = 'N' AND office_auth_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE utb_office_mst SET office_invite_code = #{inviteCode}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'
